notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one opens S1 to the C-502 strip's press fit and H1, H2 and K1 to slip clearance, and fills H2's counterbores, as the FITS paragraph of 912-001_SpanMount.scad's header gives. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
